g.text: stripe-audit
Stripe API 2026-06-24.dahlia · account live · <run timestamp>
Coverage: full — every region scanned within limits.
Findings by severity
Critical ██ 1
Info ███ 2
Findings by category
security ███████████ 4
configuration ████████████████ 6
payments 0
Critical (1)
• Webhook endpoint subscribes to all events (*)
Subscribe each endpoint to the explicit list of events it handles. Reserve `*` for debugging, never production billing.
High (8)
• Webhook endpoint is disabled
Re-enable the endpoint once the receiver is healthy, or delete it if it is obsolete so it no longer reads as a coverage gap.
• Insecure (non-HTTPS) webhook URL
Serve the receiver over HTTPS and update the endpoint URL to an `https://` origin.
• Test/local webhook endpoint on a live account
Point live endpoints at a production HTTPS origin. Use test-mode keys and local tunnels for development, never the live account.
• Customer portal does not allow payment method updates
Enable "Customer can update their payment methods" on the default portal configuration.
• Active product has no active price
Activate a price for the product, or archive the product if it is no longer sold.
• Live-mode key is seeing test data
Use a key whose prefix matches the environment you intend to audit.
• Account is not able to create charges
Complete account onboarding / verification in the Stripe Dashboard so charges are enabled.
• Account has outstanding requirements
Submit the outstanding requirements in the Stripe Dashboard before they disable the account.
Medium (15)
• Unusually many enabled webhook endpoints (12)
Audit the endpoint list and remove any that are no longer needed. Set `options.threshold` to tune this advisory for your integration.
• Duplicate webhook endpoint URL
Consolidate to a single endpoint per URL and delete the duplicates, or give each a distinct URL if duplication is intentional.
• Webhook endpoint pinned to an outdated API version
Upgrade the endpoint to the latest API version after confirming your handler tolerates the newer event shapes, or intentionally re-pin it.
• Customer portal does not offer self-serve cancellation
Enable "Customer can cancel subscriptions" on the default portal configuration.
• Customer portal does not show invoice history
Enable "Customer can view their invoice history" on the default portal configuration.
• Customer portal does not allow customer detail updates
Enable "Customer can update their information" on the default portal configuration.
• Portal plan changes apply no proration
Set the portal's subscription-update proration behavior to 'create_prorations' (or 'always_invoice') so upgrades are billed correctly.
• Active price is set to zero
Confirm the zero amount is intentional; otherwise set a non-zero unit amount.
• Product default price missing or inactive
Set the product default price to an active price.
• Product default price missing or inactive
Set the product default price to an active price.
• Active price has unspecified tax behavior
Set the price's tax_behavior to 'inclusive' or 'exclusive'.
• Customer-chosen price has no minimum
Set a minimum on the custom unit amount so pay-what-you-want has a floor.
• No default tax behavior configured
Set a default tax behavior ('inclusive' or 'exclusive') in your Stripe Tax settings.
• Stripe Tax onboarding is incomplete
Finish Stripe Tax onboarding (origin address + default product tax code) to move status to active.
• No statement descriptor configured
Set a clear statement descriptor in the Stripe Dashboard (Settings → Public details / Payments).
Low (6)
• Customer portal hosted login page is disabled
Enable the hosted login page on the default portal configuration if you want a standalone portal URL.
• Active recurring price has no lookup key
Assign a stable lookup_key to the price so your integration references it by key, not id.
• Multiple active prices for the same product and cadence
Archive the redundant prices, keeping one canonical active price per currency/cadence/amount (grandfathered prices aside).
• Product mixes multi-currency mechanisms
Pick one multi-currency mechanism per product — either separate Price objects per currency, or a single price with currency_options.
• Account branding (icon/logo) not configured
Upload a branding icon and/or logo in the Stripe Dashboard (Settings → Branding).
• No default account tax IDs configured for invoices
Set default account tax IDs in your invoice settings so they appear on every invoice.
Info (2)
• v2 event destinations were not audited
Review v2 event destinations separately in the Stripe Dashboard if your integration uses them.
• Restricted key did not grant every read scope
Grant the key read access to tax for a complete audit, or accept the reduced coverage.

Skipped rules: BILLING_MODE_NOT_MIGRATED (requires-deep), TRIAL_WITHOUT_PAYMENT_COLLECTION (requires-deep), SUBSCRIPTIONS_PAST_DUE_ACCUMULATING (requires-deep), SUBSCRIPTION_COLLECTION_PAUSED (requires-deep), METER_ERROR_NOT_MONITORED (requires-deep), HIGH_PERCENT_COUPON (requires-deep), HIGH_AMOUNT_COUPON (requires-deep), FOREVER_COUPON_STILL_VALID (requires-deep)
Suppressed (0)
